INCLUSION (wildlife-agency rule): NGPC's own page could not be read (Cloudflare). NGPC's magazine (search snippet, undated) says 'campsites are strung along a portion of the north shore of the lake', and imagery shows developed loop roads with treed site pockets, a boat ramp and parking: agency-designated camping, so ownership `state` stands. No dated NGPC wording on camping limits could be read; Campendium shows a 14-night max.

ELECTRIC unconfirmed: the note's 'some have electric' rests on camper reviews (Campendium reviewer 'pretty sure' electric was available; a Dyrt review 'no cost for electric'). No hookups group is stored; nothing changed. Site count 30 (derived) conflicts with allstays' 10 and our inclusion_evidence's '8 developed + 20 primitive'; unverified.

SAND RULE: the note's 'sandy dispersed area to the left' of the boat ramp is a secondary dispersed area; the developed sites are on gravel loops reached by the graded spur road (no sand driving needed on imagery). A developed loop that also offers sand camping stays, so no drop. A light, sandy-looking two-track runs south-west along the west shore from the loops; that is likely the dispersed area.

WATERFRONT lead: the stored 'not waterfront' (from 'lakeview') was judged at the wrong pin, so it isn't evidence. At the real camping area the ramp-side loop road runs along the shore 30-60 m from the water with a tree belt between, and the treed site pockets sit behind that road; on this rule set that is *view at best, and I can't confirm a lake view without campsite photos. Left as not waterfront (unsure stays down); a re-audit with photos might earn lakeview. The lake is large (~2+ km across).
